age.evidence: The animals were 10-12 weeks upon arrival and weighed 450 ± 50 g on the day of the experiment.

sex.evidence: A total of 24 male Wistar rats obtained from Envigo, Netherlands

dosing.evidence: animals were injected subcutaneously with either saline or psilocybin (2 mg/kg) (LAB Sweden, Stockholm, Sweden) dissolved in 0.9% saline

handling.evidence: In the subsequent week, the rats were handled for 15 min every other day, with daily handling during the week leading up to their treatment.

day_night_flipped.evidence: 12-12 h light-dark cycle with light on at 07:00 A.M.

enrichment_housing.evidence: not reported; only 'kept under standard laboratory conditions' is stated, with no mention of enrichment items

judge_notes: All three candidates agree that the paper has no behavioural assays to score. The study is a transcriptomic (3'-RNA-seq) analysis of five brain regions collected 90 min after a single s.c. dose of psilocybin (2 mg/kg) or saline. No behavioural testing was performed, so the assays array is empty.
For age, the modal candidate value (70–84 days, i.e. 10–12 weeks upon arrival) was used. Experiments began roughly 2 weeks after arrival, so confidence is medium.
enrichment_housing is set to not_reported with low confidence. The paper is silent on home-cage enrichment, so this follows deepseek4 rather than the high confidence given by the other candidates.
day_night_flipped is set to 'no' because the paper explicitly states a standard cycle with lights on at 07:00.
DOI and study_id are taken from the citation masthead in the paper: doi 10.1017/neu.2026.10075, published 2026.
